### Black Venture Capital Consortium (BVCC)

# **BVCC is a nonprofit organization whose mission is to increase diversity in the Venture Capital & Startup Ecosystem.**

[Join the BVCC Cohort!](https://www.bvcc.vc/hbcu-curriculum)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6109f49f32c86e70ec25351c/1687465773207-0NLIN5LQ9BOCGPZ04A0C/image-asset.jpeg)

We Empower Top HBCU Students

We educate, train, and place top HBCU students through our Career Track Curriculum Program, Student Consulting Projects, Student Venture Fund, paid Summer Internships, and paid full-time Fellowships. We strive to address the wealth gap by providing HBCU students with an on-ramp into lucrative careers.

BVCC cohort members have access to the tools, resources, mentorship and network needed to thrive in the highly competitive fields of venture capital and technology. Learn more about our programs and join today!

[Explore Our Curriculum Program](https://www.bvcc.vc/hbcu-curriculum)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6109f49f32c86e70ec25351c/50be31c4-f183-402f-a4fd-26a4e5398c32/famu.jpeg)

**BVCC is On-Campus at 9 HBCUs and More!**

We have student leaders at the following HBCU’s to build thriving startup ecosystems on their campuses:

Florida A&M University, North Carolina A&T State University, Howard University, Morgan State University, Grambling State University, Spelman College, Morehouse College, Clark Atlanta University, & Wellesley College. We also welcome students from **all the other HBCU’s and institutions** to participate in our programs.

# Our Programs

[![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6109f49f32c86e70ec25351c/823cb26b-fedb-494a-bfa6-3157909c60e3/3.png)](https://www.bvcc.vc/hbcu-curriculum)

### Career Track Curriculum

In our **10-week** Career Track Curriculum Program, students can select one of the **6 tracks** to study: **Venture Capital, Entrepreneurship, Product Management, and UX Design and Research.**

[![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6109f49f32c86e70ec25351c/8f608c16-13b0-4a4a-86f3-de6453d74195/2.png)](https://www.bvcc.vc/student-consulting-projects)

### consulting Projects

Our Student Consulting Projects provide top HBCU students with experiential learning opportunities such as our **Google Co-Creation Project.**

[![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6109f49f32c86e70ec25351c/723f3578-802f-49f9-8a42-612e48723051/4.png)](https://www.bvcc.vc/summer-internships)

### Summer Internships

We offer **$15,000+ summer internships** to top-performing HBCU students in the following industries: **Venture Capital, Business Development, Product Management,** and **UX Design.**

[![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6109f49f32c86e70ec25351c/f59f4dcc-edb5-4f2f-8e4a-b05c1ab69922/1.png)](https://www.bvcc.vc/hbcu-curriculum)

### Student Startup Companies

Upon successfully completing one of our Career Track Curriculum program, cohort members can **become founders or co-founders of their own startup companies.** Students have the opportunity to compete in our Spring Pitch Competition.

[![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6109f49f32c86e70ec25351c/5ba7665f-6576-4050-a3e3-b7df79d7b8fc/5.png)](https://www.bvcc.vc/student-led-venture-fund)

### Student Venture Fund

Cohort members that have successfully participated in BVCC’s Venture Capital curriculum program and/or BVCC’s venture capital summer internship program, are eligible to work as part-time paid investment analysts on BVCC’s **Venture Fund.**

[![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/6109f49f32c86e70ec25351c/0bccd97a-f629-47b2-bf9f-7cc65024f348/6.png)](https://www.bvcc.vc/fellowship-program)

### vc Fellowships

BVCC VC Interns who are graduating Seniors are eligible to apply for our 1 year **Venture Capital Fellowship Program.** Fellows will work as full-time investment professionals at a venture fund with a **salary of $85,000+.**

# For Volunteers

Volunteers **educate and empower** the next generation of leaders in the **fields of venture capital and technology**, offering guidance, mentorship, and valuable opportunities for growth.

[Learn more](https://www.bvcc.vc/volunteer-here)

# Our Impact

- We have educated **2,973** students, placed **153** students in summer internships, and placed **83** previous interns in full-time roles at VC firms, startups, and large tech companies.

- Over **50%** of our program participants have been women

- We have partnered with **42** Venture Capital Firms and **24** tech companies

- The BVCC Venture Fund has invested **$1 Million dollars into 7** startup companies created by black founders.
